meta.title: The award proposal page: "Participants" — record what happens

steps.note: Open the prepared Master QCS for the closed RFQ with its draft award proposal.
Enter the awarding flow for the existing bid event.
Open the draft award proposal page.
Confirm that the award proposal page is ready before testing its Participants control.
Click the Participants control and record whether it opens or changes anything without confirming any proposal action.
Assert that the browser remains on the award proposal page after the Participants click.
